newsitem.title: USA: Inbrand shrs soar toward Tyco bid.
newsitem.headline: Inbrand shrs soar toward Tyco bid.

text.p: Tyco International Ltd's agreement to buy Inbrand Corp for more than $300 million in stock sent Inbrand shares soaring more than 60 percent in Nasdaq trade Tuesday.
Inbrand climbed 10-3/8 to an all-time high 26-3/8 in morning trade, then eased to a 10-1/8 gain, or 63.3 percent, to 26-1/8 in unusually busy action, traders said.
Earlier, Tyco said it entered a definitive agreement to swap 0.43 of its shares for each Inbrand share, valuing Inbrand at $27.20 per share based on Tyco's $63.25 May 12 market close.

Inbrand, a maker of adult incontinence and feminine hygiene products and disposable diapers based in Marietta, Ga., agreed to the takeover four months after its shares were crushed in a sell-off related to quarterly results, according to traders.
